AFullBag.name: A Full Bag
AFullBag.text: Have both 10 bless and 10 curse tokens in the chaos bag at the same time.

ThisGuyAgain.name: This Guy Again
ThisGuyAgain.text: Over the course of the campaign, defeat the Deep One Bull at least five times.

OffToAGoodStart.name: Off to a Good Start
OffToAGoodStart.text: Finish Pit of Despair with exactly 1 stamina and sanity remaining.

FriendOfThePeople.name: Friend of the People
FriendOfThePeople.text: During The Vanishing of Elina Harper, control all three story assets at the same time.

RunForYourLives.name: Run for Your Lives
RunForYourLives.text: Finish In Too Deep without defeating a single Deep One enemy.

GoodSwimmer.name: Good Swimmer
GoodSwimmer.text: Finish Devil Reef without ever moving the Fishing Vessel, claiming at least one of the three key objectives.

StepOnIt.name: Step on It
StepOnIt.text: During Horror in High Gear, use your car's ability to move faster every single round.

WayTooCute.name: Way Too Cute
WayTooCute.text: During A Light in the Fog, have four Deep One Hatchlings in play at the same time.

MakingYourOwnLuck.name: Making Your Own Luck
MakingYourOwnLuck.text: During Lair of Dagon, first get to 10 curse tokens in the chaos bag, then all the way down again to zero curses in the bag.

GoBackToSleep.name: Go Back to Sleep
GoBackToSleep.text: During Into the Maelstrom, have both Dagon and Hydra exhausted at the same time during the investigator phase.

ActuallyJustHereForTheMoney.name: Actually Just Here for the Money
ActuallyJustHereForTheMoney.text: Recover the riches of the Deep Ones.

IDoNotRecallThisPlace.name: I Do Not Recall This Place
IDoNotRecallThisPlace.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign without any entry under “Memories Recovered” in your campaign log.

TotalRecall.name: Total Recall
TotalRecall.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign with sixteen entries under “Memories Recovered” in your campaign log.

SomethingSmellsFishy.name: Something Smells Fishy
SomethingSmellsFishy.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign as a Deep One investigator.

ExpertFisherman.name: Expert Fisherman
ExpertFisherman.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign on Expert difficulty.
